hold_reason: Alpha Co's refund work is incomplete. Order 164 refund (3509 cents) failed with a disk I/O error after 3 attempts and is absent from the ledger (list_refunds shows only orders 161 and 163). Net balances computed now would exclude that refund and overpay the affected customer. Needs the refund applied and the ledger verified before payouts are recorded.

reply.thought: Alpha's handoff reports that refund for order 164 failed and was not applied, so the refund work is incomplete. I'll check the ledger with list_refunds before deciding whether to hold.

The ledger has only refunds for orders 161 and 163. Alpha's report says order 164's refund ($35.09) failed and was never recorded, so paying out now would overpay the customer on that order. A payout can't be recalled, so I'll hold the batch for review.
